description: This file contains React components and utility functions for rendering list items in the Notesnook application, including different item types like notes, tags, trash, notebooks, reminders, attachments, and search results. It also defines placeholder data and height calculation functions for list items.

methods.name: ListItemWrapper
methods.description: React component that renders different types of list items based on the item type.

methods.name: getListItemDefaultHeight
methods.description: Calculates the default height of a list item based on its placeholder data.

methods.name: getListItemPlaceholderData
methods.description: Returns placeholder data for list items depending on group and compact mode.
